task.title: "workbook: tracked Workbook configuration does not match common project guard"
task.description:
We set up workbook in an existing project that already had several branches. One user ran `workbook setup` on a main branch, and another user was able to clone the repo and successfully sync. However, another user who already had the repo checked on on a different branch, ran `workbook setup`, and then when running `workbook sync` got this error:(
`workbook: tracked Workbook configuration does not match common project guard`

The original user then pulled main into that feature branch and pushed it up, but when the user restored their local copy to that branch, they still got the error. Deleting the .workbook/ folder also didn't solve the problem.
